remarks: Welcome to 143 Hoyt Street, Unit 5K at The Buckingham, where thoughtful updates meet flexible living. This spacious one-bedroom plus den lives like a two-bedroom, with the den easily used as a second bedroom, guest space, or private home office. The open, light-filled floor plan features an updated kitchen with a large island, stainless steel appliances, and a dining area that flows seamlessly into the living space, making it ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The living room opens to a private balcony overlooking the pool, offering a peaceful spot to start or end your day. The primary bedroom is generously sized, and the updated bath features clean, modern finishes. Recent upgrades include brand-new windows installed January 2026, three new HVAC units in 2024, and newer mechanicals including the water heater, range, and refrigerator. Enjoy full-service living at The Buckingham with a 24-hour doorman, fitness center, library, community room, pool, secure garage parking with one assigned space, and a private storage area. A rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, convenience, and versatility in one of Stamford's most desirable condominium communities.
